title: feat(spec, lint): user-facing refusal and advisory text is in the request locale; authoring findings carry a localized user sentence, security posture first
body:
Fixes #32655

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：协议里写明，报错和保存提示中给最终用户看的文字（`userMessage`）按请求的语言给出（请求语言，其次工作区默认语言，最后英文）；保存和发布返回的提示条目可以带一句 `userMessage`；7 条安全类保存提示在 11 种平台语言里都有了用户文案。
- 为什么改：执行维护者裁决「32440 选C，32043 一起按C处理」。中文用户保存后看到的是英文安全提醒；现在由出提醒的规则自己按用户语言出文案，规则 id 不变。
- 风险与回滚：只新增一个可选字段和一批文案，现有返回内容一字不变（服务端还没填这个字段，那是第 2 层的卡）；回滚就是撤回本 PR。认领里写的 `Metadata-protocol: none` 会被 Check Changeset 拒掉（见 Acceptance notes 第 1 条），需要席位改判。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.ts`（语言回退规则）、`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`（新字段的说明）、`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.user-text.ts`（各语言文案）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/finding-user-text.test.ts`，应看到 23 个测试全过，其中有带对象名的中文和英文提示。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Layer 1 of #32654 (the contract), under ruling record 6819749037 on #32440: option C of analysis 6819513436, 「服务端按请求语言返回本地化的 advisory 文案，规则 id 不变;控制台、CLI、MCP 都直接得到译文。」

**`packages/spec`.** These are descriptions and one new optional key.

- `ApiErrorSchema.userMessage` (`src/api/contract.zod.ts`) gains a "Language" section, and `EnhancedApiErrorSchema.userMessage` (`src/api/errors.zod.ts`) points to it. The text is in the request's locale. The fallback order is: the locale the request names (`Accept-Language`, or `?locale` on REST); else the workspace default (the `localization` settings); else `en`. Each one is read against the platform locale table (`PLATFORM_LOCALES` / `platformLocaleTagOf`). A locale that is not on the table, or that the producer has no text for, is skipped for the next one. The producer composes the text, and consumers render it as received. The ruled meaning is unchanged: "Producer-marked user-facing refusal text, verbatim" (objectui#5210). Only the language is new.
- `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` (`src/api/protocol.zod.ts`) is the one finding shape behind the save and publish doors' `advisories[]` and the 422's `issues[]`. It gains an optional `userMessage` with the same name, the same producer-marked meaning and the same locale rule. `rule` is still the stable id, and `message` / `hint` are still the developer-facing English. A response without the key parses exactly as before, and a client that parses one with the key now keeps it instead of stripping it.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/api/*.mdx` (13 pages carry the error envelope) and `authorable-surface/api.json`, which now lists `api/RuntimeAuthoringIssue:userMessage`. `authorable-surface.base.json` is unchanged.

**`packages/lint`: the producer side.** The catalog lives with the producer, which is the lane's call within the ruling.

- `AuthoringFinding.userTextParams?` holds the names a finding's user sentence interpolates. A rule cannot see the request, so it emits names, not text.
- `finding-user-text.ts` holds the types, the locale order (`userTextLocaleOf` / `renderUserText`), `mergeUserTextCatalogs` (which refuses a rule id that two catalogs both claim) and `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG`. `findingUserMessage(finding, [requestLocale, workspaceDefault])` returns the `userMessage` value, or `undefined` when the producer authors no sentence. It is exported from the root entry and from `@objectstack/lint/runtime`, which is the entry `metadata-protocol` is pinned to.
- `validate-security-posture.user-text.ts` sits beside the rule. It holds one sentence per advisory rule id in all 11 platform locales, using the console's own terms (`权限集`, `查看所有记录`, `读取范围`, …). The seven rules are `security-private-no-readscope`, `security-master-detail-ungranted`, `security-book-audience-unknown-set`, `security-superuser-field-mask-inert`, `security-controlled-by-parent-master-reference-hidden`, `security-update-policy-no-check` and `security-controlled-by-parent-owner-policy-without-opt-in`. Their eight push sites in `validate-security-posture.ts` now set `userTextParams`. Rule ids, messages and hints are unchanged. The owner-policy sentence follows the rule's hint: it prescribes the opt-in only where the opt-in actually lets the owner edit.

**Not in this PR.** The save door composing `userMessage` (layer 2, #32656) and the console rendering it (layer 3, #32657). `metadata-protocol`'s `toIssue` still copies the six keys, so every save and publish response is byte-identical until #32656 lands.

## Why

The console renders a server advisory such as `security-private-no-readscope` in English inside a zh-CN Studio. The ruling puts the translation where the rule's wording lives, so the console, the CLI and MCP all get the localized text and no consumer keeps its own per-rule translation table.

## Tests

All counts are from final head `9925cc13`, which is `b22507da` with `origin/main` `fa1134c6` merged in through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`. The merge had no conflicts, and `check:generated` reported all 14 artifacts up to date after the rebuild.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 200 passed (200), Tests 8559 passed (8559). The lock reported `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Before the merge, at `b22507da`, the count was 8532/8532.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 836 passed (836), Tests 26732 passed, 1 todo. `VERDICT command-exit 0`. At `b22507da` it was 26714 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0. The test-typecheck debt is unchanged in both packages.
- New `packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.test.ts` (23 tests):
  - the locale order: alias reads (`zh-CN` resolves to `zh-Hans`), the workspace default when the request locale is unset, off the table (`pt-PT`) or has no sentence (`ja`), and `en` as the floor for an unknown locale (`tlh`);
  - the duplicate-catalog refusal, and no sentence for a finding without params;
  - the catalog holds exactly the 7 ids, each in exactly the 11 platform locales;
  - every push site rendered from the rule's real findings in every locale: the names are interpolated, no `undefined`, and the text is a real translation rather than the English stand-in;
  - zh-Hans and en text with the set and object names;
  - the remedy variants and the bypass variants;
  - a `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` permission write whose advisory renders a `userMessage` that `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` accepts beside the unchanged rule id.
- New spec pins in `src/api/protocol.test.ts`: the finding parses with and without `userMessage`; a non-string value is refused; the save response keeps a localized `userMessage` on an advisory.

<details><summary>Ablation (one, at b22507da, in the expected direction: red)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts --anchor "            userTextParams: { permissionSet: psName, object: objName },(newline)" --delete -- pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/finding-user-text.test.ts`

The anchor count went from 1 to 0, and the blob went from `ffd0f96f4b26` to `8c3f3ec817cb`. Result: Tests 3 failed | 20 passed (23). The three failures are exactly the cases that read the private-object finding: its push site, the zh-Hans/en pin and the runtime-gate pin. After restore the blob equals HEAD (`ffd0f96f4b26`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the rule from `src`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

</details>

<details><summary>Reverse type check (cross-package type change)</summary>

I compiled a temporary probe in `packages/lint/src` (deleted afterwards) against the rebuilt `@objectstack/spec` `.d.ts`. It typed three objects as `RuntimeAuthoringIssue`. The two with a string `userMessage`, one of them an object literal that the excess-property check would refuse without the declared key, compiled. The one with `userMessage: 42` gave the only error: `TS2322: Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'string'`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

1. **`Metadata-protocol: none` conflicts with the `Check Changeset` level gate.** The two declaration lines above are copied verbatim from the claim (6820254697). With that body, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main --event EVENT.json` exits 1 with: "metadata-protocol declares `none` while an authorable-surface or authorable-defaults baseline moved. Moved: packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json". The ratchet's `api` shard records response keys too, and the gate prescribes `Metadata-protocol: added` with `@objectstack/spec` at `minor`. The seat owns that declaration, so this PR does not change it. The report's `open_questions` carry the choice.
2. **Remaining advisory rules: the card's scope, reported with counts rather than truncated.** I ran a static scan over the registry entries the save door runs: 38 of 65 `AUTHORING_RULES` carry `runtime-publish`, and their import closure covers 89 files. It finds 74 lint rule ids emitted at `warning` / `info`. This PR covers 7 of them (`validate-security-posture.ts`), which leaves 67 (×11 locales) for the seat to card. The script and the per-file list are in the report. `metadata-protocol`'s runtime authoring gate also adds its own advisories (`public-form-intake-unavailable`, the draft-time hierarchy-scope warning, html-page compile warnings, the storage-refused notice). Those are layer 2's producer, not lint's.
3. **Translations were written by an agent and have not had native review.** The terms follow the console's own packs (`ui/packages/i18n`), but the ar / de / es / fr / ja / ko / pt-BR / ru / zh-Hant sentences deserve a native read before they are user-facing at scale.
4. **CLI JSON grows one key.** `os validate --json` / `os build --json` serialize findings as they are, so the seven security advisories now also show `userTextParams` in `warnings`. The change is additive, and no CLI test pins that element's exact shape.
5. For layer 2 (#32656): in `toIssue` (`metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`), add `userMessage: findingUserMessage(f, [requestLocale, workspaceDefaultLocale])` when it is defined. Import it from `@objectstack/lint/runtime`. Passing both locales matters: `ExecutionContext.locale` folds them into one value, which drops the workspace default when the request names a locale that is not on the table.

## Verification

Run on final head `9925cc13` (the derived list is unchanged from `b22507da`):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 113 commands for this diff, and every one exited 0.
  - `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 1. This was local stale build state from the merge, not this diff: `main` added `@objectstack/metadata`'s `./stored-item-package` entry. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata build`, both exit 0: 258/258 declarations present, and 123 require entries across 72 packages load.
  - `--ran` reconciliation (each line recorded as `COMMAND :: exit CODE`): "113 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 113 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- The first pass at `31275b30` found one real hit, which is fixed in `b22507da`. `check:cli-command-ids` read a pt-BR template segment starting `os seus titulares` as an `os` command literal. The line is reflowed and the gate is green.
- The same pass hit four exit-3 prerequisites. They were cleared by fetching the teardown self-test's pinned commit and building the `client-react` / `objectql` closures; all four are measured green at the final head.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: only `check:docs` was stale. `--fix` regenerated only that artifact, and the build's `gen:schema` wrote the `api` shard. A rebuild at the final head leaves the tree clean.
- `check:changeset-no-major` without a PR payload reads the level axis as not applicable. With the claimed body, it gives the refusal in Acceptance note 1.
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config` on the 11 changed TypeScript files: exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` run is CI's.
- The full CI farm, `test:repo` included, is CI's.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
